description: Lists the open documents (one per window): id, name, path, unsaved changes, revision, which one is active.
name: list_documents

description: Creates a new icon (one group, one empty layer) – reuses an untouched new window, else opens a new window.
name: new_document

description: Opens a .icon file (absolute path, bundle folder or ZIP) – or shows its window if it is open.
name: open_document

description: Saves a document to its file, or to `path` (absolute, may ask the user first) in `format` (bundle folder or zip).

id.description: Document id = window label from list_documents ("main", "doc-2"); default: the last active window

name: save_document

description: Brings the window of a document to the front; tools without id then work on it.

id.description: Document id = window label from list_documents ("main", "doc-2"); default: the last active window

name: activate_document

description: The document: name, path, revision, unsaved, undo step, selection, the asset list and icon.json (groups, layers, fill …).

id.description: Document id = window label from list_documents ("main", "doc-2"); default: the last active window

name: get_document

description: The SVG source of an asset (as saved, without internal ids), at most max_chars (default 20000, at most 200000).

id.description: Document id = window label from list_documents ("main", "doc-2"); default: the last active window

name: get_asset_svg

description: The hierarchy: root, groups, layers and their SVG nodes (kind, label, tag, node ref, fill/stroke swatch, hidden), depth-first, at most max_nodes (default 500, at most 5000).

id.description: Document id = window label from list_documents ("main", "doc-2"); default: the last active window

name: get_tree

description: One SVG node: tag, attributes, text, children, and its bounding box in icon units (0…1024) as the browser measures it.

id.description: Document id = window label from list_documents ("main", "doc-2"); default: the last active window

node.description: A node of an SVG asset: {asset: asset file name, id: internal node id} (from get_tree)

name: get_node

description: The selected nodes and icon items (groups/layers).

id.description: Document id = window label from list_documents ("main", "doc-2"); default: the last active window

name: get_selection

description: Runs one document command as JSON, e.g. {"type":"setAttributes","changes":[{"ref":{"asset":"a.svg","id":"n3"},"name":"fill","value":"#f00"}]} or {"type":"setIconJsonValue","path":["fill"],"value":{"solid":"srgb:1.00000,0.50000,0.00000,1.00000"}}. One undo step.

expected_revision.description: Fail with revision_conflict if the document changed since this revision (get_document, or the last write's answer)

id.description: Document id = window label from list_documents ("main", "doc-2"); default: the last active window

name: run_command

description: Lists the actions run_action may run (id, label, group, enabled, argument schema) – the same as menus, palette and keyboard.

id.description: Document id = window label from list_documents ("main", "doc-2"); default: the last active window

name: list_actions

description: Runs an action of the app with arguments, e.g. add.circle {cx, cy, r, fill}, icon.setFill {fill}, properties.set {name, value}, edit.delete. One undo step; the answer has the new revision and selection.

expected_revision.description: Fail with revision_conflict if the document changed since this revision (get_document, or the last write's answer)

id.description: Document id = window label from list_documents ("main", "doc-2"); default: the last active window

name: run_action

description: Inserts SVG markup (one element, several, or a whole <svg>) like the SVG Snippet command – cleaned, centred unless it has a transform, into `parent` (a container node ref) or the current target. One undo step.

expected_revision.description: Fail with revision_conflict if the document changed since this revision (get_document, or the last write's answer)

id.description: Document id = window label from list_documents ("main", "doc-2"); default: the last active window

parent.description: A node of an SVG asset: {asset: asset file name, id: internal node id} (from get_tree)

name: insert_svg

id.description: Document id = window label from list_documents ("main", "doc-2"); default: the last active window

items.description: A node of an SVG asset: {asset: asset file name, id: internal node id} (from get_tree)

description: Exports PNGs (resvg) into a folder: <name>-<appearance>-<size>.png. May ask the user first.

dir.description: Absolute path of an existing folder

id.description: Document id = window label from list_documents ("main", "doc-2"); default: the last active window

name: export_png

description: Exports one flat SVG per appearance into a folder: <name>-<appearance>.svg. May ask the user first.

dir.description: Absolute path of an existing folder

id.description: Document id = window label from list_documents ("main", "doc-2"); default: the last active window

name: export_svg

description: Renders the icon as a PNG image (the export path) so you can see the result: size 16…1024 (default 512), appearance light/dark, mask (default squircle).

id.description: Document id = window label from list_documents ("main", "doc-2"); default: the last active window

name: render_preview
